about: Outbound marketing rules for six EMEA markets. Built from public sources. Not legal advice. Every rule starts unverified until a person reads the source and updates the verification block.

bases.opt_out: Allowed without consent. Identify yourself, offer an opt out and honour objections.
bases.consent: Needs prior consent unless an exception applies.
bases.presumed_consent: Needs a concrete, documented reason to expect the recipient wants the contact.

UK.name: United Kingdom
UK.existing_customer: Soft opt in for individual subscribers: details collected in a sale or negotiation, similar products, a chance to opt out at collection and in every message.

email_company.summary: Companies are corporate subscribers. Email is allowed without consent. Name the sender and give a valid opt out address.

email_sole_trader.summary: Sole traders and some partnerships are individual subscribers. Email needs consent or the soft opt in.

call_company.summary: Live calls are allowed unless the number is on the CTPS or the company has objected.

call_sole_trader.summary: Live calls are allowed unless the number is on the TPS or CTPS or the person has objected.

IE.name: Ireland
IE.law: European Communities (Electronic Communications Networks and Services) (Privacy and Electronic Communications) Regulations 2011, S.I. No. 336 of 2011, Regulation 13
IE.existing_customer: Regulation 13(11): details collected in a sale, similar products, a chance to object at collection and in every message, contact within 12 months of the sale.

email_company.summary: Regulation 13(4): email to a subscriber that is not a natural person is allowed unless it has objected.

email_sole_trader.summary: Treated as consent needed. Regulation 13(2) may allow business email to individuals at a work address. Confirm whether that covers sole traders.

call_company.summary: Live calls to a landline are allowed unless the subscriber has objected or recorded a preference in the National Directory Database.

call_sole_trader.summary: Landline calls are allowed unless the person has objected or opted out in the National Directory Database. Regulation 13(6): calls to a mobile need consent.

DE.name: Germany
DE.regulator: No single regulator. Competitors and consumer associations enforce through the courts. Bundesnetzagentur acts on calls to consumers.
DE.existing_customer: §7(3): own address collected in a sale, own similar products, no objection, a clear opt out at collection and in every message.

email_company.summary: §7(2): advertising by email needs prior express consent. This applies to B2B email too.

email_sole_trader.summary: §7(2): advertising by email needs prior express consent, including to sole traders.

call_company.summary: §7(2): calls to other market participants need at least presumed consent. A concrete business reason must exist before the call.

call_sole_trader.summary: Sole traders called in their business capacity are other market participants. Presumed consent applies.

FR.name: France
FR.law: Code des postes et des communications électroniques (CPCE) article L.34-5
FR.regulator: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés (CNIL)
FR.existing_customer: L.34-5: details collected in a sale, analogous products, a chance to object at collection and in every message.

email_company.summary: CNIL guidance: email to professionals is allowed without consent if the subject relates to their job and they can object.

email_sole_trader.summary: The statute requires consent for individuals. CNIL guidance treats professional addresses as opt out when the subject relates to their job. Confirm this for sole traders.

call_company.summary: Live calls to professionals are allowed. Honour objections.

call_sole_trader.summary: Calls about their trade are allowed. From 11 August 2026 calls to consumers need prior consent and Bloctel has closed. Confirm a sole trader is called as a professional, not as a consumer.

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.existing_customer: Article 11.7: details collected in a sale, similar products, a chance to object at collection and in every message. For calls, customers from the last three years.

email_company.summary: Article 11.7: email marketing needs prior consent. Since 2009 this covers companies too.

email_sole_trader.summary: Article 11.7: email marketing needs prior consent.

call_company.summary: Live calls to companies are allowed. Honour objections.

call_sole_trader.summary: Since 1 July 2021 calls to natural persons need consent. Customers from the last three years are an exception. The Bel me niet register has closed.

ES.name: Spain
ES.law: Ley 34/2002 (LSSI) article 21 and Ley 11/2022 General de Telecomunicaciones (LGTel) article 66
ES.regulator: Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD)
ES.existing_customer: LSSI article 21.2: prior contract, own similar products, a simple way to object at collection and in every message.

email_company.summary: LSSI article 21: commercial email needs prior express consent. This applies to companies too.

email_sole_trader.summary: LSSI article 21: commercial email needs prior express consent.

call_company.summary: LGTel article 66: calls can run on legitimate interest. Screen against Lista Robinson and honour objections.

call_sole_trader.summary: LGTel article 66: calls can run on legitimate interest. Screen against Lista Robinson and honour objections.
